content.content: {"result":"{\"success\": true, \"data\": {\"path\": \"/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_9/projects/event-gated-adaptive-horizon/paper_framing.md\", \"content\": \"# Paper Framing: Diagnostic Analysis of Temporal Abstraction in World-Model RL\\n\\n## Title Candidates\\n\\n1. **\\\"Why Temporal Abstraction Fails in DreamerV3: A Diagnostic Analysis of Variable-Rate Imagination\\\"**\\n2. ~~**\\\"The Delusional Critic Problem in DreamerV3's Variable-Rate Imagination\\\"**~~ (deprecated — \\\"delusional critic\\\" conflicts with Lu et al. 2018)\\n3. **\\\"Diagnosing Value Overestimation from Temporal Abstraction in DreamerV3\\\"** ← preferred after D037 terminology decision\\n4. **\\\"Conditioning-Induced Value Overestimation in Variable-Rate World-Model Imagination\\\"**\\n\\n**⚠️ D037 术语决定**: \\\"delusional critic\\\" → **\\\"conditioning-induced value overestimation\\\"** (简称 CIVO)。Lu et al. 2018 的 delusional bias 指 policy-class constraints 导致不可实现的 Q 值，本文机制是 model imprecision + learned conditioning amplification，概念不同。Dream 模拟三档审稿一致指出术语误导。全文替换：\\\"delusional critic\\\" → \\\"conditioning-induced value overestimation\\\"，可 cite Lu et al. 2018 as analogy but must explicitly differentiate。\\n\\n**⚠️ D037 TAWM 对比（关键 novelty 升级）**: TAWM (Nhu et al., ICML 2025) 在 TD-MPC2 (MPC setting) 中成功使用 dt-conditioning。本文发现 dt-conditioning 在 imagination-based actor-critic 中失败 → **novelty 从 \\\"known failure class 的 specific instance\\\" 升级为 \\\"dt-conditioning succeeds in MPC but fails in imagination — here's the architecture-specific vulnerability\\\"**。TAWM 是强化 novelty 的最关键参考文献。\\n\\n## Venue\\n\\n**ICML 2026** — Deadline: 2026-05-29\\n\\n## Narrative Positioning\\n\\nThis is a **diagnostic analysis paper**, not a method paper. We do not propose a new algorithm. Instead, we provide a systematic, controlled investigation answering: *Why does temporal abstraction fail in world-model RL?*\\n\\nThe contribution is a **strongly supported causal chain** from mechanism to failure mode, backed by a factorial experiment design that isolates each factor, plus a **practical mitigation guideline** (restrict imagination to dt=1 during multi-dt training → 95% baseline recovery). Diagnostic papers are valued when they (a) address a widely-attempted but poorly-understood failure, (b) provide actionable insight for future method design, and (c) are methodologically rigorous.\\n\\nWe scope all claims to **DreamerV3 and its RSSM world model**. Generalizability to other latent-dynamics architectures is discussed but not claimed.\\n\\n---\\n\\n## Core Claims\\n\\n### C1: Variable-rate imagination in DreamerV3 consistently degrades performance\\n\\nTemporal abstraction via variable dt—whether learned or fixed—degrades asymptotic performance relative to the dt=1 baseline across all tested configurations.\\n\\n| Evidence | Experiment | Key Metric |\\n|----------|-----------|------------|\\n| Baseline stability | exp_001_baseline (dt=1) | Stable convergence ~950 eval return |\\n| Fixed dt=2 collapse | exp_006_fixed_dt2 (dt=2, subsample ON, H=15) | Peak 485@35K → collapse to ~135@65K |\\n| Fixed dt=4 severe degradation | exp_007_fixed_dt4 (dt=4) | Peak 176.9@25K, 144.4@45K (33% of baseline@45K=443) |\\n| Learned gate collapse | exp_005 (learned gate) | Peak 541@55K → 99@145K |\\n\\n**Strength**: Strong. Three independent dt>1 configurations all show degradation. No positive result exists for variable-rate imagination in our setup.\\n\\n### C2: Trained dt_embedding creates susceptibility to CIVO with stochastic onset; necessity confirmed by ablation\\n\\n**D032/D156 update: CIVO onset is stochastic (Walker 3/3, Cheetah 3/4); necessity confirmed (frozen 0/10 across 2 envs × multiple seeds, removed 0/3+). Cross-env frozen verification 4/4 closed (exp_084-087, all NVE < 0.53×). Fisher exact test (6/7 onset vs 0/19 controls): p < 0.0001.**\\n\\nThe trained dt_embedding creates susceptibility to pathological value overestimation (normalized v/e >1.5x baseline) with stochastic onset. Both onset and collapse are stochastic:\\n\\n- **Walker WITH trained dt_emb**: 3/3 seeds onset NVE>1.5× (exp_008d s0: sustained 1.71x@35K→2.09x@45K→4.12x@55K → collapse; exp_009e s1: onset >1.5×; exp_009b s2: 1.62x@45K → self-correction to 0.38x@105K). 2/3 sustained collapse, 1/3 self-corrected\\n- **Cheetah WITH trained dt_emb**: 3/4 seeds onset (exp_078 s0 NVE=4.1×; exp_091 s2 NVE=138.7×, onset_collapse; exp_097 s3 onset@45K NVE=2.3×, onset_transient_then_degraded, eval_final=61.7 (14% baseline); exp_088 s1 NVE≈1.0 no onset). **All onset seeds eval_final < 15% baseline; no-onset s1 = 69% baseline — CIVO onset causes irrecoverable performance damage even when ve_ratio self-corrects**\\n- **WITHOUT dt_emb (frozen/removed)**: 0/10 frozen (exp_042, exp_067, 015b, 047, 057, 084, 085 Walker; 046, 058, 086, 087 Cheetah; note: 047/057 had transient spikes 1.71-1.88× but self-corrected) + 0/3 removed (008f s1, 009c s2, exp_069 s1) exceed sustained nve>1.5×. Cross-env frozen verification (exp_084-087, 2 envs × 2 seeds): all NVE<0.53×\\n- **1.5x threshold (Walker, 35K+)**: 4/4 perfect classification within Walker. Cross-environment onset rate ~86% (6/7 completed seeds) — not deterministic\\n\\n**⚠️ 时间限定**: nve>1.5x 诊断适用于 **35K+ steps**（此时 baseline v/e 已充分收敛至 >0.24，比率稳定可靠）。25K 处 baseline v/e 仅 0.087，微小绝对差异可被放大为大比率（如 009b@25K nve=2.05x 和 008e_v3@25K nve=1.93x 均为 false positive）。论文中报告 threshold 时必须标注此限定。\\n\\n**Sustained vs transient overestimation**: The key difference between collapse (008d seed 1) and self-correction (009b seed 2) is the **temporal persistence** of nve>1.5x. WITHOUT dt_emb: 0/2 seeds exceed nve>1.5x (008f peak 1.02x, 009c peak 1.26x). **4/4 perfect classification.** |\\n| **Causal control: dt_embed_dim=0 (direction confirmed, seed-dependent)** | exp_008f seed 1 + exp_009c seed 2 | **Seed 1**: eval 197→207→194→173→503@105K (zigzag recovery); nve 1.02x→0.73x→0.83x→0.97x→0.30x. **Seed 2**: eval 169→211→239→359→227→191→148@105K (decline after 75K); nve 1.26x→0.79x→0.72x→0.33x→0.60x→0.90x→1.14x. architecture)** | exp_016e (reward_dt_emb_detach=True, subsample ON, H=8, seed 1) | Peak eval 326.7@75K → collapse 31.7@95K, NVE=10.42x. 梯度验证揭示 reward loss 对 dt_emb.weight 贡献为 0——reward_dt_emb_detach ## Venue

**ICML 2026** — Deadline: 2026-05-29

## Narrative Positioning

This is a **diagnostic analysis paper**, not a method paper. We do not propose a new algorithm. Instead, we provide a systematic, controlled investigation answering: *Why does temporal abstraction fail in world-model RL?*

The contribution is a **strongly supported causal chain** from mechanism to failure mode, backed by a factorial experiment design that isolates each factor, plus a **practical mitigation guideline** (restrict imagination to dt=1 during multi-dt training → 95% baseline recovery). Diagnostic papers are valued when they (a) address a widely-attempted but poorly-understood failure, (b) provide actionable insight for future method design, and (c) are methodologically rigorous.

We scope all claims to **DreamerV3 and its RSSM world model**. Generalizability to other latent-dynamics architectures is discussed but not claimed.

---

### C1: Variable-rate imagination in DreamerV3 consistently degrades performance

Temporal abstraction via variable dt—whether learned or fixed—degrades asymptotic performance relative to the dt=1 baseline across all tested configurations.

### C8: Forward-pass interventions — TCN and RAVE (🔄 验证中)

**⚠️ D107/D108: 两种 forward-pass 干预方法并行验证**

SGS 失败的根因是 backward-pass 干预无法消除 forward-pass representational damage。C8 提出绕过梯度冗余的 forward-pass 干预：

**TCN (Temporal Conditioning Noise)**:
- 设计理念：imagination 时对 dt_embedding 输出加高斯噪声 $\mathcal{N}(0, \sigma^2)$，降低 conditioning 精度
- 机制假说：噪声阻止 RSSM 和 critic 对精确 dt 信号的过度 co-adaptation，同时保留粗粒度时间信息
- 与 SGS 的区别：在 forward pass 层面操作，不依赖梯度阻断
- 超参：σ=0.5×std（主实验）+ σ=0.2×std（替代超参）
- 实验：exp_027_tcn_walker_s0 (σ=0.5), exp_027_tcn_walker_s0_sigma02 (σ=0.2)

**RAVE (Reality-Anchored Value Estimation)**:
- 设计理念：用 EMA 跟踪真实环境状态的值估计，当 imagined value 超过 EMA×ceiling 时截断
- 机制假说：直接限制 critic overestimation 的幅度，打断 CIVO 正反馈循环
- 与 SGS 的区别：不修改梯度流，而是在 value estimate 层面施加约束
- 超参：ceiling=2.0（主实验）+ ceiling=1.5（替代超参）
- 实验：exp_028_rave_walker_s0 (ceil=2.0), exp_028_rave_walker_s0_ceil15 (ceil=1.5)

## Story Arc

### 1. Introduction
- Temporal abstraction is a long-sought goal in RL (options, macro-actions, skip connections)
- World-model RL (DreamerV3) offers a natural testbed: modify imagination dt without changing environment interaction
- Puzzle: all our attempts at variable-rate imagination degrade performance. Why?
- Contribution: systematic factorial diagnosis identifying trained dt_embedding as creating susceptibility to conditioning-induced value overestimation (CIVO, nve>1.5x) with stochastic onset (Walker 3/3, Cheetah 3/4); removal/freezing consistently blocks it (0/7+). The vulnerability is deeper than imagination quality — even dt=1 imagination collapses at the same rate when dt_embedding is trained, revealing that training data dt>1 transitions alone drive the critic exploitation feedback loop

### 2. Background & Related Work
- Temporal abstraction in model-free RL (options framework, FiGAR, action repeat)
- World-model RL (Dreamer family, IRIS, TWM)
- Variable-rate planning in world models (few prior works, mostly positive framing)
- Value overestimation in model-based RL (delusional bias per Lu et al. 2018 — differentiate from our CIVO)

### 3. Methodology
- DreamerV3 as base architecture
- Variable-rate imagination: dt_embedding, temporal subsampling, learned gating
- **Factorial experiment design**: 2×2×2 grid (dt_embedding trained/untrained × subsample ON/OFF × H=8/15) + baselines
- Diagnostic metrics: eval return, value/eval ratio as overestimation proxy, learning curves

### 4. Results
- **Finding 1**: All dt>1 configurations degrade (C1)
- **Finding 2**: Controlled ablation isolates trained dt_embedding (C2) — the "smoking gun" comparison (008c vs 008d)
- **Finding 3**: Untrained dt_embedding prevents optimistic drift, sustaining near-baseline performance (C3)
- **Finding 4**: Longer dt amplifies (C4)
- **Finding 5**: Horizon/subsample effects are secondary (C5)
- **Finding 6 (D153 confirmed)**: dt=1 imagination deterministically prevents CIVO (4/4 seeds, current code after gate_max_dt bug fix). Practical mitigation: retain trained dt_embedding benefits while eliminating CIVO trigger pathway (C6)

### 5. Discussion
- Mechanism: why trained dt_embedding causes CIVO (RSSM fidelity gap at dt>1)
- RSSM fidelity analysis: Walker 008d reward gap (1.63x, v3 standardized) vs 008f reward gap (1.01x); Cheetah trained_dt_emb reward gap (1.00x) — environment-dependent transmission pathway (D158)
